(define (add_expense amount category)
  (unless (and (real? amount) (> amount 0)) (error 'add_expense "amount must be positive"))
  (unless (and (string? category) (> (string-length category) 0)) (error 'add_expense "category required"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [es (hash-ref s 'expenses '())])
    (set-state! (hash-set s 'expenses (append es (list (hasheq 'amount amount 'category category)))))
    (add1 (length es))))

(define (set_budget category amount)
  (update-state! (lambda (s)
                   (hash-set s 'budgets (hash-set (hash-ref s 'budgets (hasheq)) (string->symbol category) amount))))
  amount)

(define (over_budget)
  (let ([spent (by_category)])
    (sort (for/list ([(c b) (in-hash (hash-ref (get-state) 'budgets (hasheq)))]
                     #:when (> (hash-ref spent c 0) b))
            (symbol->string c))
          string<?)))

(define (top_category)
  (let ([spent (by_category)])
    (for/fold ([best 'null]) ([c (in-list (sort (map symbol->string (hash-keys spent)) string<?))])
      (if (or (eq? best 'null)
              (> (hash-ref spent (string->symbol c)) (hash-ref spent (string->symbol best))))
          c
          best))))

(define (add_expense amount category [note 'null])
  (unless (and (real? amount) (> amount 0)) (error 'add_expense "amount must be positive"))
  (unless (and (string? category) (> (string-length category) 0)) (error 'add_expense "category required"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [es (hash-ref s 'expenses '())]
         [e (hasheq 'amount amount 'category category)])
    (set-state! (hash-set s 'expenses (append es (list (if (eq? note 'null) e (hash-set e 'note note))))))
    (add1 (length es))))
